# Drugwatch

> > Drugwatch is a consumer health and safety resource providing comprehensive information on dangerous drugs, medical devices, FDA warnings, and product liability lawsuits.

Founded as an independent watchdog, Drugwatch tracks pharmaceutical and medical device safety issues, covering major cases like Roundup cancer litigation, hernia mesh complications, and FDA black box warnings. The site features expert medical reviewers including pharmacists, nurses, and legal professionals who provide evidence-based analysis of drug side effects, device recalls, and mass tort litigation.

## Key Topics

- FDA warnings and black box warnings
- Product liability and mass tort litigation
- Drug side effects and safety risks
- Medical device complications
- Mesothelioma and asbestos exposure
- Cancer risks from pharmaceuticals and consumer products
- Lawsuit settlements and eligibility
- Rheumatoid arthritis treatments
- Talcum powder diseases
- Benzene exposure and leukemia
- SSRI antidepressants and suicide risks
- Hernia mesh complications
- Medical device recalls
- FDA regulatory oversight
- Consumer health advocacy

## Major Drug & Device Lawsuits

- [Roundup Lawsuit: (March 2026) Cancer Claims, Settlements & Eligibility](https://www.drugwatch.com/legal/roundup-lawsuit): Roundup glyphosate lawsuits: $7.25B settlements for lymphoma claims
- [Hernia Mesh Risks, Lawsuits & FDA Warnings](https://www.drugwatch.com/hernia-mesh): Hernia mesh complications, FDA warnings & product liability lawsuits
- [Mesothelioma Lawsuits | Free Case Review (2026)](https://www.drugwatch.com/mesothelioma/lawsuits): Mesothelioma lawsuits against asbestos manufacturers including J&J talc
- [Yaz Lawsuit Settlements - Blood Clot, Heart Attack, Stroke Settlements](https://www.drugwatch.com/yaz/settlements): Bayer settled 18,000+ Yaz/Yasmin lawsuits for blood clot injuries
- [Power Morcellator Lawsuits | Allegations, MDLs & Settlements](https://www.drugwatch.com/morcellators/lawsuits): Power morcellator lawsuits for spreading cancer during hysterectomy
- [Abiomed Impella Heart Pump Lawsuit: Latest Updates and Recall](https://www.drugwatch.com/legal/abiomed-impella-heart-pump-lawsuit): Abiomed Impella heart pump lawsuits for injuries & deaths after recall
- [Penumbra JET 7 Xtra Flex Catheter Lawsuits | Recall, Injuries in Litigation](https://www.drugwatch.com/penumbra-jet-7-xtra-flex-catheter/lawsuits): Penumbra JET 7 catheter recall lawsuits for device malfunctions & injuries
- [Benzocaine Lawsuits | Methemoglobinemia Injuries](https://www.drugwatch.com/benzocaine/lawsuits): Benzocaine teething product lawsuits for methemoglobinemia & infant deaths

## High-Risk Drugs & Treatments

- [Humira | What Is Humira Used For and How Do You Use It?](https://www.drugwatch.com/humira): Humira (adalimumab) for autoimmune treatment: uses, side effects & warnings
- [Actemra: Side Effects and Safety Risks You Should Know About](https://www.drugwatch.com/actemra): Actemra (tocilizumab) side effects, infection risks & black box warnings
- [Kratom: Health Effects, Addiction Risks & Safety](https://www.drugwatch.com/kratom): Kratom health effects, addiction risks & opioid/stimulant properties
- [Side Effects of Drugs, Medical Devices & High-Risk Medical Conditions](https://www.drugwatch.com/side-effects): Common drug & medical device side effects tracked by FDA FAERS system

## Cancer & Toxic Exposure Risks

- [Benzene: Health Risks, Exposure & Leukemia](https://www.drugwatch.com/benzene): Benzene exposure health risks, leukemia links & lawsuit eligibility
- [Talcum Powder Diseases | Cancer & Respiratory Illness Studies](https://www.drugwatch.com/talcum-powder/additional-diseases): Talcum powder links to lung, uterine cancer & respiratory diseases
